POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL superuser username. Required by image-based Postgres (not auto-injected).

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: Master DB password — referenced by all consumer services via shared variable.

PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory under the volume mount. Volume is mounted at /var/lib/postgresql (parent), PGDATA is the data subdirectory — fixes initdb lost+found collision.

DATABASE_URL.description: Auto-constructed from POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, PRIVATE_DOMAIN, and POSTGRES_DB.
